# entrepot_system_info (Data Source)

Information about the Entrepot server: version, public URL, supported formats and enabled authentication features.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "entrepot_system_info" "this" {}

output "entrepot_version" {
  value = data.entrepot_system_info.this.version
}

output "supported_formats" {
  value = [for f in data.entrepot_system_info.this.formats : f.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `anonymous_access` (Boolean) Whether anonymous access is enabled server-wide.
- `base_url` (String) Public base URL of the server (used in repository URLs).
- `formats` (Attributes List) Supported repository formats. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--formats))
- `gitlab_instances` (List of String) GitLab instances whose CI job tokens (`id_token`) are accepted.
- `oidc_display_name` (String) Display name of the OIDC provider (empty when disabled).
- `oidc_enabled` (Boolean) Whether OIDC single sign-on is enabled.
- `version` (String) Server version.

<a id="nestedatt--formats"></a>
### Nested Schema for `formats`

Read-Only:

- `kinds` (List of String) Repository kinds the format supports (`hosted`, `proxy`, `group`).
- `name` (String) Format name, e.g. `npm`.
